verdict.rationale: Parahelp is a SaaS support-agent platform, so data portability is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has no documented bulk export, open-format download or offboarding capability. Knowledge version history, the option to disable personal data storage, and a request API are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not a data export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
